The previous trade proposal to player four for Tennessee Avenue was likely rejected or expired. I still hold the pink monopoly and use Tennessee to block their orange set. I am now deciding my post-turn action.

I collected $200 for passing GO. I can build two houses on my pink properties. The even building rule allows a one-house difference.

Virginia Avenue yields the highest rent at two houses. I can build one house there for $100 and keep $110, or distribute two houses evenly across my pink properties.

Leaving only $10 after building two houses is too risky. I am mapping the standard board order from Baltic to plan my next roll.

Selling all three houses would only raise cash to $360, still too little to survive a light blue rent hit. No properties remain mortgageable. Building more houses would worsen my financial position rather than help. I must raise cash immediately through a trade before my next roll. Player four owns the light blue properties that create this death zone.
